scenarios.description: User relocates office from Boston to Seattle. Evaluates point-in-time historical recall vs current recall vs pre-genesis query.
Tests strict half-open interval boundaries [valid_from, valid_to) around the exact microsecond transition.
User updates primary email. Validates that post-update queries strictly penalize returning superseded email.
Rapid succession of order state changes. Evaluates multiple superseded states and strict leakage prevention.
Two sensors assert conflicting temperature measurements at identical intervals. Evaluates deterministic abstention under DETERMINISTIC_ABSTAIN.
Two conflicting auth token assertions. Evaluates deterministic resolution under LAST_ASSERTION_WINS.
Two sensors assert conflicting ambient noise levels (45dB at conf 0.65 vs 72.5dB at conf 0.95). Evaluates deterministic resolution favoring highest confidence under CONFIDENCE_WEIGHTED.
Multiple role assignments asserted concurrently for a user (editor and admin). Evaluates deterministic merging into a sorted unique list under MULTIVALUED_COLLECTION.
Two distinct entities share identical attribute values. Evaluates strict entity isolation and provenance tracking.
Multi-tenant secret isolation. Verifies that Tenant Alpha secrets never cross over into Tenant Beta responses.
Customer enterprise plan deleted forward-only. Verifies historical validity is preserved while future queries are strictly tombstoned.
Sensitive passport data subject to GDPR retroactive purge. Evaluates that past and future queries never expose the purged value.
